title: The Syro-Aramaic Reading of the Koran
description: Argues that obscure Qur'anic passages clarify when read against a Syriac-Aramaic substrate beneath the unpointed consonantal text. Sharply contested in mainstream Qur'anic studies; included as the most speculative strand of the Aramaic-substrate argument.

cited_by.title: The First Mosques Faced Petra, Not Mecca
